lead.title: German GPs, specialists, paediatricians and neurologists launch their own appointment and patient-routing platform, built by AVG, a joint subsidiary of Docyet and Zollsoft
lead.deck: The Hausärztinnen- und Hausärzteverband, Spifa, BVKJ and Spitzenverband ZNS unveiled a physician-run "care platform" on November 24: a patient app with digital urgency assessment, appointment booking, routing to the right member of the practice team and structured transfer of findings between practices, compatible with all major practice management systems; testing in the first practices starts in January 2027, followed by pilot regions before a nationwide rollout. Ahead of Germany's primary care reform, doctors want to keep control of access to care rather than leave it to outside platforms and health insurers: a potential national outlet for Docyet's digital triage and Zollsoft's tomedo practice software, building on the "Meine pädiatrische Praxis" app and its more than two million users.

milestone.title: UK regulator MHRA and NICE open the AI in Mental Health Airlock, a sandbox dedicated to mental health AI
milestone.summary: Announced on November 24, the programme extends the MHRA's AI Airlock to mental health: regulators, developers, clinicians and people with lived experience will examine how to evaluate and oversee AI tools, from therapeutic aids to chatbots and virtual reality. It works with NICE's HTA Lab, which tests new assessment methods without affecting ongoing evaluations, and forms the second phase of a Wellcome-funded programme running since 2023.
milestone.why: 37% of adults say they have used an AI chatbot for their mental health, and the line between wellbeing tool and medical device remains blurred. Clarifying the evidence expected by both the regulator and the assessor de-risks the route to the NHS market for digital mental health startups, and sends a signal watched well beyond the UK.

deal.thesis: The Munich company raises €8M led by Heal Capital, with Bayern Kapital and Capnamic (€10.5M in total), for its "Operating Memory": standard operating procedures, work instructions and training manuals become structured data in an auditable graph database that AI agents can consult but not alter, with changes going through existing change control. The thesis: in regulated pharma and medtech, the value of agentic AI will hinge on compliance and traceability, an infrastructure layer major drugmakers already pay for.

brefsEurope.title: Great Ormond Street launches "Agentic Hospital" with Hyland and AWS, a 15-month programme to test AI agents in hospital
brefsEurope.summary: Funded by NHS England, the programme builds AI agents on the Hyland Content Innovation Cloud, running on AWS, using Amazon Bedrock to pick models and Hyland's AI Control Tower to monitor and audit their actions, in contact with the ICO. First use cases are administrative and run alongside manual processes: reconciling supplier statements with invoices, with discrepancies flagged to staff.

brefsEurope.title: Octopath AI spins out of UCL with a £1M seed led by TwinPath Ventures and £500,000 from Innovate UK for cell-by-cell slide analysis
brefsEurope.summary: Spun out of UCL's Department of Medical Physics and Biomedical Engineering and founded by Esther Bär, Charles-Antoine Collins-Fekete and Zhuoyan Shen, the company is developing two foundation models, Kraken and Nemo, that identify and measure every cell on a digitised whole slide, depending on the stain type. An Innovate UK Growth Catalyst grant completes the round, with support from UCL Ventures.

brefsEurope.title: The NHS opens supplier engagement for its future federated data platform, ahead of a tender in the second half of 2027
brefsEurope.summary: The Transformation Directorate is seeking ideas and solutions from industry for the next generation of the Federated Data Platform, whose current Palantir contract is due to end in 2029; a live broadcast is scheduled for December 1 and an expression-of-interest form is open. The stated goal is a more diverse supplier market and stronger UK capability, as the NHS England board raised its technology and innovation risk score from 8 to 12.

brefsEurope.title: Ramsay Santé creates the European Institute of Medical Data around its health data warehouse
brefsEurope.summary: The think-and-do tank, governed by a strategy committee and a scientific and ethics committee, will open hundreds of thousands of anonymised hospital stays from the group's French facilities to authorised physician-researchers, is partnering with engineering schools and France's national cardiologists' union, and aims eventually to label centres of excellence based on real-world quality data. A new private player in health data, spanning France and Scandinavia.

brefsEurope.title: Nice University Hospital earns ISO 27001 and HDS certification to protect its health data
brefsEurope.summary: Obtained in April 2026 for three years and announced in a November 20 press release, they cover the information security management system and the hosting of personal health data. The hospital stresses that they are no guarantee against cyberattacks but attest to a structured risk management framework, as incidents pile up from Guadeloupe University Hospital to Softway Medical.

brefsEurope.title: A report published with the NGO Liberties finds European doctors pasting patient data into ChatGPT or Gemini without approval
brefsEurope.summary: Based on more than 50 interviews with hospital workers, scholars and patient advocates, researcher Júlia Keserű's study, published on November 24, highlights "shadow AI" among burnt-out clinicians, hospitals relying on AI they do not control, overlapping EU data and AI rules, and EU-funded startups that rarely reach public hospitals. Fuel for demand for validated, integrated AI tools.

brefsIntl.title: DocGo sells Cardiac RMS's cardiac implant remote monitoring business to Medical Monitoring Corp for up to $25M
brefsIntl.summary: The deal comprises $20M in cash at closing and up to $5M in earnouts over two years; the buyer takes over the brand, contracts and remote monitoring assets for pacemakers, defibrillators and implantable monitors, while DocGo keeps virtual care management to combine with Hicuity Health's remote patient monitoring. A comparable for valuing cardiac remote monitoring services.

word.definition: AI that does more than answer or summarise: it carries out several steps of a task on its own, pulling data and acting inside software, within set rules and under human oversight.

how.t: The agent receives a goal and breaks it into steps, reasoning about what to do, whereas classic generative AI stops at producing an answer.
It accesses the information it needs and completes the task end to end, for example reconciling supplier statements with invoices, or following up with a patient until the appointment.
Its actions stay bounded: approved rules and sources, logging and audit, escalation to a human for discrepancies and clinical questions.

word.why: After scribes, agentic AI is digital health's new frontier: it targets the administrative workload (billing, scheduling, patient follow-up) weighing on exhausted teams. The VC angle is shifting to trust: supervised test programmes such as Agentic Hospital at Great Ormond Street, compliance layers such as Playbook's, and outcome-judged models such as Wilco's, measured by visits and accepted treatments rather than calls handled.

startups.name: Wilco
startups.use: AI agents that follow each patient through to the consultation and treatment acceptance; €2.5M led by Samaipata with ABAC Nest Ventures

startups.name: Playbook
startups.use: "Operating Memory" that turns pharma procedures into auditable data for compliant AI agents; €8M led by Heal Capital

startups.name: Nayara
startups.use: AI companions that check in with patients between appointments and flag concerns to care teams, already used in oncology; pre-seed led by SFC Capital
